title: Grove Ridge
about:
Grove Ridge by Emaar is a contemporary residential development set within the green heart of Emaar South, Dubai’s emerging golf-centric community. Overlooking the championship 18-hole golf course, the project features a refined collection of 1, 2 and 3-bedroom apartments and limited 3-bedroom townhouses, designed with open-plan layouts and expansive balconies that frame uninterrupted views of lush fairways. Developed by Emaar, Grove Ridge blends modern architecture with nature-inspired interiors, creating homes that feel calm, spacious, and connected to the outdoors.

Residents enjoy access to resort-style amenities, landscaped gardens, and wellness-focused facilities, all within a master-planned destination that balances leisure, lifestyle, and long-term value. With its strategic location near Al Maktoum International Airport and Expo City Dubai, Grove Ridge offers an ideal choice for both end users and investors seeking growth in Dubai South’s future-ready corridor.

location_tile.title: Emaar South – Dubai’s Next Growth Destination
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Grove Ridge is located within Emaar South, a master-planned community in Dubai South, designed around an 18-hole championship golf course and expansive green landscapes. This strategic destination sits close to Al Maktoum International Airport (DWC) and Expo City Dubai, positioning it at the centre of Dubai’s future economic and logistics hub. The community is planned to include schools, healthcare facilities, retail outlets, hotels, and leisure zones, creating a self-sufficient lifestyle environment. With direct access to major highways such as Emirates Road and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, Emaar South connects seamlessly to Dubai Marina, Downtown Dubai, and key business districts. It is a prime choice for families, professionals, and investors looking to be part of Dubai’s next major growth corridor.

  • 5 mins – Al Maktoum International Airport
  • 30 mins – Dubai Marina
  • 35 mins – Downtown Dubai & Burj Khalifa
  • 40 mins – Sheikh Zayed Road
  • 45 mins – Dubai International Airport
